summary: Iteration 13 — Uber Eats-style UI/UX overhaul of FoeGuard menu verified on mobile 390x800 against the brand-color/layout spec. 13/15 spec items PASS. 2 items partially verified (could not auto-confirm Notes textarea after tab click; could not locate a /treat/{id} link from /menu and could not confirm checkout per-item subscription list renders without first toggling subscribe-save). All critical brand-color and layout rules verified programmatically: aged-wood announcement bar, transparent product cards, brown-pill-only-when-active for category nav AND box-size slider, 2-col mobile grid, + button anchored to card bottom-right, no floating 'View basket' pill, sharp Checkout button, full-width product hero with small X close, swipable badges row, 'Change on menu' banner, Details/Notes tabs, cart drawer 'Add items' + 'Go to checkout' + subscribe-save section, Harvest-Gold cart badge, small 34x34 X close on meal-plan and calculator pages.

integration_issues.issue: [data-testid="subscription-items"] and [data-testid^="sub-item-"] NOT found on /checkout after navigating with selected proteins. Spec requires this list to render so each protein/treat can be individually pre-selected for subscription. May be conditional on subscribe-save being toggled in cart first (couldn't verify); main agent should confirm rendering rule.

No anchor matching a[href*="/treat/"] found on /menu page (default 'Raw dog food' category). Treats are only reachable after clicking the 'Raw dog treats'/'Raw cat treats' category pill — main agent should confirm a treat card click does navigate to /treat/{id} with the same Uber-Eats pattern (full-width hero, X close, swipable badges, qty +/-, floating Add pill).

announcement_bar.text: 'Free delivery in the GTA over $100' (sentence case) PASS

category_nav.active_dog_food: bg #3B2A1A brown pill, color #D8CFB8, radius 999px PASS
category_nav.rule: ONLY active becomes brown pill, others text-only PASS

box_size_slider.rule: ONLY selected size is brown pill, others khaki PASS

add_button_position.cd-chicken_btn_right: 188px = card right 188px (anchored bottom-right of card) PASS
add_button_position.cd-chicken_btn_bottom: below image (top 709 vs card top 450) — at bottom-right of CARD CONTENT not on image PASS

verifications.no_floating_view_basket: PASS — only match for /view\s*basket/ was inside an inlined CSS <style> block (.basket-pill is declared but not rendered on menu)

product_detail_page.add_pill: Brown floating pill present (showed 'Box full' because earlier +1 filled the 6lb box — UX disable state OK; default state when box has room should show 'Add 6lb to your box · $26.99' per spec, fresh-session verification recommended)

cart_drawer.proceed_checkout_testid: cart-proceed-checkout — 'Go to checkout' (not 'Proceed to Checkout') PASS
cart_drawer.subscribe_save_testid: cart-subscribe-save — 'Save extra $1.35 — subscribe & save 5% / Free delivery. Pause, skip, or cancel anytime.' PASS

action_items: Verify per-item subscription list on /checkout — [data-testid="subscription-items"] and [data-testid^="sub-item-{id}"] did not render in my run. If it's gated on subscribe toggle, document; otherwise wire it to render whenever there are selected proteins/treats.

Treats route smoke-test: confirm clicking a card under 'Raw dog treats' / 'Raw cat treats' opens /treat/{id} with the Uber-Eats pattern (full-width hero, product-close-btn, badges, qty +/-, floating Add pill that returns to /build-box).

Default product-detail Add pill: open a fresh-session /product/cd-chicken (no items yet) and confirm pill renders as 'Add 6lb to your box · $26.99' rather than 'Box full' (only saw the latter because my earlier + click had filled the 6lb box).
critical_code_review_comments: Cart drawer + product detail + menu category nav use consistent data-testid hooks — testability good.
Subscription list testids (subscription-items, sub-item-{id}) are referenced in the spec but not rendered on /checkout in my run; verify the conditional or unconditional render path.

success_rate.frontend: 87% (13/15 spec items confirmed; 2 need main-agent confirmation on subscription list + treats route)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Mobile-first menu overhaul verified on https://foeguard-dev-site.preview.emergentagent.com at 390x800. /menu is BoxBuilder. Key passing checks: announcement bar #3B2A1A sentence-case, category text-nav with only-active brown pill, 'Choose your box' label, box-size slider with only-selected brown pill, 2-col grid with transparent cards, + button at card bottom-right (testid='add-{id}'), no floating View basket pill, sharp Checkout (no box-shadow), Harvest-Gold cart badge (testid='nav-cart-badge'), product card image click navigates to /product/{id} while + click stops propagation. Product detail: hero, product-close-btn, product-badges (swipable), change-box-size 'Change on menu' link, no size circles, Details/Notes tabs, floating brown Add pill. Cart drawer: cart-add-items '+ Add items', cart-proceed-checkout 'Go to checkout', cart-subscribe-save section. Meal-plan and calculator have 34x34 circle close (meal-plan-close-btn / calc-close-btn). PENDING confirmation: (a) checkout per-item subscription list (subscription-items / sub-item-{id}) did not render on /checkout in this run, (b) treats route smoke-test from menu (Raw dog treats category) — switch to that pill first to find /treat/{id} anchors, (c) Add pill default state when box not yet full.
